description: Tap a grid-field and publish it as VALUE — a bare rows×cols matrix (val-matrix), the full grid with its world frame (val-grid), plus val-rows / val-cols. The bridge from the grid / DEM pipeline into the Matrix nodes. Forwards the grid on.
instructions:
Wire any grid node (Grid, Fill Depressions, Flow Accumulation, Grid Distance, …) into this node to expose its lattice as JSON — DECOUPLING the numbers from the on-canvas heatmap:

 • `val-matrix` — the cell values as a bare rows×cols 2D array `[[…],[…],…]` (row-major). Feed this into the Matrix nodes (Transpose / Multiply / Inverse / Least Squares).
 • `val-grid` — the same values plus the world frame `{ rows, cols, minX, minY, cellW, cellH }`, so the result can be georeferenced back onto the canvas.
 • `val-rows` / `val-cols` — the lattice dimensions, for Math / Output.

The grid is forwarded unchanged on the main output, so this can sit inline (e.g. Flow Accumulation → Grid Geometry → Render Grid). Draws nothing itself.
